title: No entry without a permit
goal: Read and use the formal without, -mAksIzIn, and turn it into everyday -mAdAn.

intro.text: Notices, reports and news say `-mAksIzIn` for **without**: *Ziyaretçiler izin almaksızın kazı alanına giremez*. In conversation, `-mAdAn` does the same job: *izin almadan*. Unlike `-mAdAn`, `-mAksIzIn` never means **before**.

vocab.en: area, field; site (kazı alanı: excavation site)

exercises.question: Which sentence says the same thing in everyday Turkish? *Ziyaretçiler izin almaksızın kazı alanına giremez.*
options: Ziyaretçiler izin almadan kazı alanına giremez.
Ziyaretçiler izin aldıktan sonra kazı alanına giremez.
Ziyaretçiler izin almak için kazı alanına giremez.

why.1: *Aldıktan sonra* is **after getting** permission: the opposite.
why.2: *Almak için* is **in order to get** permission.

exercises.explain: `-mAksIzIn` and `-mAdAn` both mean **without**; `-mAksIzIn` is the formal one.

exercises.en: At the meeting he talked for two hours without stopping.

reject.why: *Dururken* is **while stopping, while standing**. **Without stopping**: *durmaksızın* or *durmadan*.

exercises.explain: After the front vowel e: *-meksizin*. The suffix has only two forms, *-maksızın* and *-meksizin*.

accept: They worked all night without sleeping.
They worked all night without [any sleep|getting any sleep|sleep].
They worked [the whole night|all through the night] without [sleeping|any sleep].
They worked without sleeping all night.

exercises.explain: *Dokunmak* takes the dative: *eserlere dokunmayın*. A museum sign would write *Eserlere dokunmayınız*.

exercises.tr: Ziyaretçiler izin almaksızın kazı alanına giremez.
exercises.en: Visitors may not enter the excavation site without permission.

exercises.question: Which one means **before going to bed**?

why.1: `-mAksIzIn` only means **without**: *yatmaksızın*, without going to bed.

exercises.prompt: We worked for five hours without a break.

exercises.text: Arkeologlar üç yıl ara ___ kazı yaptılar.
exercises.en: The archaeologists dug for three years without a break.
exercises.explain: *Ara vermeksizin*: **without a break**, in the formal style of reports.

accept: The attendant closed the door without warning anyone.
The attendant closed the door without [warning|any warning|a warning|giving anyone a warning].
The [official|guard|staff member|employee] closed the door without [warning anyone|warning|any warning|a warning|giving anyone a warning].
Without warning anyone, the [attendant|official|guard|staff member|employee] closed the door.
